versions.changelog:
- Initial public release for systematic project landing risk assessment.
- Provides an end-to-end framework covering project identification, risk analysis, and mitigation recommendations.
- Features eight risk assessment dimensions (construction, funds, operation, market, policy, compliance, credit, regional support).
- Offers four-level risk grading and actionable advice for government, park, and enterprise decisions.
- Standardizes evaluation output to support pre-signing review, implementation monitoring, and comprehensive project management.
